note: SKNode of iOS 7 (and SKEffectNode, SKScene and SKView of iOS 7, in facts/SpriteKit/SKScene.md; SKTexture and SKSpriteNode of iOS 7, in facts/SpriteKit/SKTexture.md and SKSpriteNode.md): the class and the surface the port carries, the node tree, the frame, the hit tests and the conversions. The SDK's member rows carry no availability of their own (the class's 7.0 applies), except where a row says otherwise. Members owed to later objects are rows too, so an application that sends one gets the runtime's unrecognised-selector error and not a silent nil.
